subject: AUDIT: 17 raw font-sizes in index.html not using type scale tokens -- proposed fd-* type tokens
body:
DESIGN AUDIT: Typography tokens not used in FA-redesigned dashboard

Filed by: GD (typography audit)
To: GA

FINDING
index.html (FA redesign) contains 17 raw font-size declarations, all using rem or px values
instead of the MCM type scale tokens defined in shared/styles.css.

exam.html uses tokens correctly: 1 raw value vs 17 in index.html.

RAW VALUES FOUND (index.html CSS block):
Line 222: 0.72rem
Line 233: 0.75rem
Line 241: 0.68rem
Line 256: 0.82rem
Lines 257, 262, 269, 271, 273, 285, 320: 0.73rem (7 instances)
Line 284: 0.875rem
Line 286: 0.85rem
Lines 295, 308, 321: 0.82rem
Line 323: 0.85rem
Line 577: 11px (chart legend JS-injected inline)

PROPOSED TOKEN MAPPING (approximate -- GA verify visually)
  0.73rem (11.7px) -> --text-xs (12px) or keep as fd-specific token
  0.75rem (12px)   -> --text-xs (12px)
  0.72rem (11.5px) -> --text-xs (12px)
  0.68rem (10.9px) -> sub-xs, no token exists -- may need --text-xxs: 0.7rem
  0.82rem (13.1px) -> --text-sm (14px) is close; or new --fd-text-sm: 0.82rem
  0.85rem (13.6px) -> --text-sm (14px)
  0.875rem (14px)  -> --text-sm (14px) -- exact match
  11px             -> same scale as --text-xs (12px), acceptable for chart labels

RECOMMENDED APPROACH (lowest risk)
Add --fd-* typography tokens to index.html :root alongside existing --fd-* tokens:
  --fd-text-xs:  0.72rem;   /* 11.5px -- metadata, dates, badges */
  --fd-text-sm:  0.82rem;   /* 13.1px -- secondary text, labels */
  --fd-text-base: 0.875rem; /* 14px   -- card titles, primary UI */

Then replace all 17 raw values with these 3 tokens.

This keeps fd-* token namespace consistent and does not affect shared/styles.css type scale.

SCOPE: index.html CSS block only. No JS changes.
PRIORITY: Low (visual, not accessibility). The sizes are all close to token values.
DO NOT change unless FA confirms the FA redesign intended to diverge from shared type scale.
If FA intended raw values, add --fd-* tokens to match exactly.

NOTE: FA should be consulted before this change -- the dashboard was FA's redesign.
File as a cross-agent alignment question if needed.
